content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the AIIMS Jodhpur Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download AIIMS Jodhpur Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 8 vacancies are available – 1 for Project Technical Support III and 7 for Project Nurse III.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Technical Support-III: Three-year graduate degree in Nursing (B.Sc. Nursing/Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing), Allied Health Sciences from a recognized university, with three years of post-qualification experience in clinical research, multicentric research projects, neonatal/pediatric care, public health research, or related field; OR Postgraduate degree in any of the above disciplines from a recognized university. Project Nurse-III: Diploma in General Nursing or midwife AND Registration with the State/Indian Nursing Council. Desirable: B.Sc. Nursing with experience of working in labour room, maternity ward, neonatal care, and clinical research projects.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Technical Support-III / Project Nurse-III posts at AIIMS Jodhpur is scheduled for 10 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jodhpur has announced a total of 8 vacancies for the positions of Project Technical Support-III and Project Nurse-III through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: For the Project Technical Support-III post, candidates need a three-year graduate degree in Nursing or Allied Health Sciences with three years of experience, or a postgraduate degree in the relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for both Project Technical Support-III and Project Nurse-III posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 33,600 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 35 years. Age relaxation rules, if any, will be as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this walk-in recruitment drive by AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Jodhpur vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the AIIMS Jodhpur office. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for the exact venue and reporting time.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, these positions are contractual in nature. The recruitment is for specific project-based roles within AIIMS Jodhpur.
